translations.web: “You shall say to them, ‘Any man there is of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,
translations.bsb: Tell them that if anyone from the house of Israel or any foreigner living among them offers a burnt offering or a sacrifice
translations.kjv: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,
